newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil October consumer good imports up 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil October consumer good imports up 29 pct.

text.p: Brazilian imports of consumer goods rose 28.9 percent in October from September, while capital good imports rose 22.9 percent, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
It said imports of non-durable consumer goods stood out, increasing 37.6 percent. Imports of durable consumer goods, not including automobiles, increased 20 percent.
Imports of primary commodities rose 10.5 percent, while imports of fuel and lubricants increased 2.3 percent.
